title: Define and prove the canonical product-disc contract
objective: Turn the approved Living Core disc expression into a complete, portable product-object contract covering geometry, mark placement, scale, static and animated allocation, surfaces, responsive behaviour, accessibility and channel boundaries.

included: perfect circular mask and hard-edge geometry
canonical white Wings placement and clearspace
compact, default, card and focal scale bands
exact static twin versus approved animated runtime allocation
light, dark, card, family, small-size and failure fixtures
responsive, reduced-motion, WebGL-failure, overflow and contrast proof
excluded: sphere shading or hero sphere contract
rounded card, pill, stack, bundle or trading-card contract
new gradient palettes or product assignments

acceptance: one schema-validated source defines geometry, scale, Wings, allocation, surface, channel and accessibility rules
generated contract is deterministic and never mutates gradient or foundation authority
candidate status and promotion authority are explicit
five approved product cores prove the same disc chassis
source, exact static twin and runtime approximation are compared honestly
small, responsive, dark, reduced-motion, failure and collection contexts are visible
human verdict can be recorded without changing canonical assignments

verification.passCondition: circle, hard edge, scale bands, Wings ratio and clearspace match the declared contract
source PNG, exact static twin, renderer, product assignment and foundation hashes remain unchanged
one focal animated disc and repeated static discs remain coherent without glow, tiles or arbitrary chassis changes
reduced-motion, WebGL failure, small-size, light/dark and 320-to-1440 responsive proofs remain legible and stable
Olli approves the disc contract for promotion

humanGate.approvalQuestion: Does this disc contract make the Living Core feel like one precise, ownable product object across focal, card, collection and small-size contexts without turning it into generic gradient decoration?

stopConditions: a build changes a source PNG, extracted palette, exact static twin, renderer, product assignment or canonical foundation
the disc gains sphere shading, an inset tile, halo, glow cloud, floating motion or non-circular geometry
repeated family or dense contexts animate by default
the task introduces sphere, card, stack, homepage, Figma or consumer-specific work
runtime approximation is presented as exact source colour
notes: Begin with a read-only comparison of the approved five product sources, static twins and current disc runtime.
Use one chassis, many cores: only approved gradient and copy may distinguish equal products.
This task locks the disc contract only; the expression-family gate remains later programme work.
